note: The one copy of the four source labels and of every source line the console pages show (Overview, Check a sale, Proof, For judges). A page names a source by key; theme/sources.js builds the visible line (the plain source, then its date; the line number only where exact is asked, the Proof page) and the title (full path and cited lines). (R6 2026-11-12) Each label also has a sentence-case name, the only form shown on the page; kind stays the key. tests/frontend_source_labels.mjs checks every cited line against its file and that the pages use keys, not typed strings.
